caption:
You finish the job. Then the phone rings for the next one.

That's the moment most reviews die. The ask gets skipped because nobody remembers to make it.

The Black Arrow platform closes that gap. Mark a job won and the review request fires on its own. No one on your team has to remember.

Every request logs next to the job it came from. You always know who's been asked and who hasn't.

Run it on your own jobs. 14 days free, no card required.

rationale: Fills the under-served Platform/Trial slot with an unclaimed pain (the review ask that quietly never happens between jobs) using the platform's verified automated review engine, distinct from every prior tool-sprawl, lead-scoring, inbox, reporting, and booking-friction angle already shipped.
